faqs: What is your refund policy?
Refunds are processed within 7 business days of approval.
How do I reset my password?
Use the Forgot password link on the login page.
What are your business hours?
We are open 9am to 6pm, Monday to Saturday.
Do you ship internationally?
Yes, we ship to 40 countries.
How long does delivery take?
Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days.
Can I cancel my order?
Orders can be cancelled before they are shipped.
What payment methods do you accept?
We accept cards, UPI and net banking.
How do I track my order?
Use the tracking link in your confirmation email.
Do you offer cash on delivery?
Cash on delivery is available for orders under 5000 rupees.
How do I contact customer support?
Email support@acme.example or call 1800-123-456.
Is there a warranty on products?
All electronics carry a one-year manufacturer warranty.
Can I change my delivery address?
You can change the address until the order is dispatched.
Do you have a mobile app?
Our app is available on Android and iOS.
How do I apply a discount coupon?
Enter the coupon code at checkout before paying.
What is the Gold plan?
The Gold plan includes free shipping and priority support for 999 rupees a year.

documents.text:
# Return and Refund Policy

## Clause 4.1 Return window

You may return most items within 30 days of delivery. Items must be unused and in their original packaging.

## Clause 4.2 Damaged items

If an item arrives damaged, report it within 48 hours with photos. We will replace it or issue a full refund at no cost to you.

## Clause 4.3 Return shipping

Return shipping is free for damaged or incorrect items. For all other returns a flat fee of 99 rupees is deducted from the refund.
